name: Fort William Historical Park RV Park

fees.note: $25 a night for a non-serviced site; serviced sites (20/30/50-amp outlets and a fresh water connection) $40; plus HST. Open May 15 - October 12 in 2026. Fort William Historical Park's campground page, read 2026-10-12.
